packages/org.vibevm.ai-native/jtd-codegen/v0.1.0/README.md:5-9 ; xtask/src/codegen.rs ; schemas/specmap.jtd.json
README:5-9 states exactly this, citing RFC 8927. The host uses it: xtask codegen.rs drives jtd-codegen and a committed schemas/specmap.jtd.json (9326 bytes) is the source of truth. Matches.

BOSS CORRECTION: the gathered row cited `schemas/specmap.jtd.json` (with a byte count) as an example of the committed schemas. That file DOES NOT EXIST - `schemas/` holds seven report schemas (init_report, install_plan, install_report, list_report, registry_publish_report, registry_sync_report, uninstall_report) and no specmap one. The FACT still holds: the host does derive its wire types from committed `*.jtd.json` schemas through this binary, driven by `xtask/src/codegen.rs` into `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/`. Verdict confirmed on the corrected evidence, not on the row as filed.
